judgments.rewrite_hint: 対象文: “The idea was that those carrying the cargo would repay the money the United States spends to keep the strait safe.” 支払う主体は特定せず、米国の安全確保費用の償還案として述べてください。参照: HF-003。
対象文: “with its distant danger reaching gasoline prices and the cost of moving goods through crude oil.” ガソリン価格や物流費への波及は外し、Ledgerが確認した原油先物の値動きの範囲に狭めてください。参照: HF-006。
